parameters.query: UPDATE ranking_demo.profile_rooms SET adjustment_score = $1 WHERE room_key = $2;

SELECT r.room_key AS RoomKey, r.location_key AS BranchKey, r.adjustment_score AS scoreAdjustment, CASE WHEN r.adjustment_score = CAST($1 AS SIGNED) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS UpdateVerified FROM ranking_demo.profile_rooms AS r WHERE r.room_key = $2 LIMIT 1;

parameters.content:
## Restore Ranking - Outlook CSV Intake

1. Add the same Microsoft Outlook OAuth2 credential to all three Outlook nodes.
2. MySQL and Salesforce credentials were copied from the previous workflow.
3. The ranking API URL and configuration were copied from the previous workflow.
4. Activate only after sending a test email.

Accepted request:
- Sender ends with @example.com
- Subject contains: Restore Ranking
- Exactly one CSV attachment (the filename can be anything)
- CSV headers: RoomKey,AccountKey

AccountKey is optional. RoomKey is required. The workflow replies once, after every CSV row finishes. No Excel sheet or permanent audit table is used.
